reason: It's aimed right at how I report to clients, but it's brand new with no reviews, and the part I'd actually pay for, the branded before/after links, isn't in the free plan, so I can't see it before I pay. I'll run the free tier on one client site this month and decide after that.
objection: I'd be putting my agency's name on links from a service nobody has heard of yet. If a capture comes out wrong or the link dies, that's my credibility with the client, not theirs. And part of me still thinks my developer could script full-page screenshots on a cron job in an afternoon.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real branded before/after link before I pay, ideally opened on my phone the way my clients would see it, through a sample page or a short free trial of the Agency plan.
